text: Ffion rang. Said someone come in at eleven and wouldn't say what for. Didn't say it was the three o'clock.
style: Contract security guard in his fifties. Speak with a consistent South London / Estuary English accent throughout -- do not shift to any other accent. Low, slightly gravelly pitch; slow, flat pace. Tired, dry and procedural; not stupid, and not paid enough to be a hero.
